queries_run: Tesla distribution channel shift 2026 sales stores online
Tesla business model transition subscription FSD robotaxi platform 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025：汽車銷售通路為官網與自有門市網路，部分地區設展示廳（不交易）；能源產品另透過通路夥伴與 PPA 銷售。
findings.excerpt: Our vehicle sales channels currently include our website and a global network of company-owned stores. In some jurisdictions, we also have galleries to educate and inform customers about our products, but such locations do not transact in the sale of vehicles.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋顯示 FSD 已停售一次性買斷、僅月訂閱 $99（2026-02-14 起），訂閱數 Q2 2026 約 1.48M；僅有搜尋摘要未取得可逐字原文，列為 clues。

clues.claim: Tesla 於 2026-02-14 後停止 FSD 一次性買斷，僅剩月訂閱；Q2 2026 財報會議摘要稱 FSD 訂閱 1.48M、年增 56%（次級來源）
clues.source: notateslaapp Summary of Tesla's 2026 Q2 Earnings Call
